valid.name: lexical-bindings-and-assignment
valid.source:
(defvar total 0)
(defun add (value)
  (let* ((next (+ total value)) (text (str next)))
    (setq total next)
    (print text console/log)))
(export add total)

valid.name: imports-and-special-forms
valid.source:
(import "view-runtime" :default View create-view)
(defun render (ready items)
  (cond
    (ready (create-view "main" (js-object :className "ready") items))
    (t (create-view View (js-object :state "waiting" :items items)))))
(export View create-view render)

valid.name: expression-surface
valid.source:
(defun exercise (target key)
  (let ((plain 1))
    (vector
      (lambda (value) (put target key value))
      (get target key false)
      (js-call target :run plain)
      (js-object key plain)
      (quote missing)
      (js* "globalThis"))))
(export exercise)

valid.name: object-primitives
valid.source:
(defun objects (value key)
  [(object-keys value)
   (object-has? value key)
   (object-assoc value key 1)])
(export objects)

(defun object (value) value)

valid.name: framework-names-remain-bindable
valid.source:
(defun jsx (value) (+ value 1))
(defun fragment (value) (+ value 2))
(defun defcomponent (value) (+ value 3))
(defun exercise () [(jsx 1) (fragment 1) (defcomponent 1)])
(export jsx fragment defcomponent exercise)

valid.name: optional-and-rest-parameters
valid.source:
(defportable collect (required &optional optional &rest rest)
  (js-array required optional rest))
(defconst invoke (lambda (first &optional second &rest tail) [first second tail]))

valid.name: async-functions-and-await
valid.source:
(defasync resolve-value (value &optional transform)
  (let ((resolved (await value)))
    (if transform (await (funcall transform resolved)) resolved)))
(defconst delayed-double (async (value) (* (await value) 2)))

valid.name: stack-safe-loop-and-recur
valid.source:
(defun triangular (n acc)
  (if (= n 0) acc (recur (1- n) (+ acc n))))
(defconst swapped
  (loop ((left 1) (right 2) (steps 1))
    (if (= steps 0) [left right]
      (recur right left (1- steps)))))

valid.name: exception-control-flow
valid.source:
(defun recover (value)
  (try
    (if value value (throw "missing"))
    (catch error (str "caught:" error))
    (finally (print "done"))))
(defasync settle (promise)
  (try (await promise)
    (catch error error)
    (finally (await promise))))

valid.name: vector-binding-patterns
valid.source:
(defportable pair-sum ([left right]) (+ left right))
(defun unpack ([first [second nil third] &rest tail] &optional [fallback])
  (let* (([head &rest rest] tail) ([nested] [fallback]))
    [first second third tail fallback head rest nested]))
(defun recover ()
  (try (throw [7 "caught"])
    (catch [code message] [code message])))
